person_detect_int8.tflite -- third-party, vendored test fixture (not Alp Lab's own).

Size:        300568 bytes

This is the canonical TFLite-Micro "person detect" MobileNet: int8-quantized
throughout (verified against the flatbuffer schema, not assumed -- every
tensor is TensorType.INT8 or INT8-typed INT32 bias; input tensor `input` is
INT8 [1,96,96,1], output tensor `MobilenetV1/Predictions/Reshape_1` is INT8
[1,2]). Already bench-verified on real E1M-AEN801 (E8) Ethos-U85 silicon --
see examples/aen/aen-npu-inference-person-mram/README.md -- and re-verified
compiling clean with `ethos-u-vela` for this fixture's use as the Ethos-U
real-model proof in tan-cli's `tests/model/test_vela_yolo_internal.py`:

    vela --accelerator-config ethos-u85-256 person_detect_int8.tflite
      -> CPU operators = 0 (0.0%), NPU operators = 44 (100.0%)
      -> Neural network macs 7077252 MACs/batch

Vendored here (rather than fetched from the tflite-micro Zephyr module at
build time, the way the Zephyr example above does it) because this fixture is
consumed by a host-side Python test with no west/Zephyr build in its path --
see NOTICE for the third-party-components entry.
